# data/external/

Raw DepEd and PSA datasets reused as inputs to this analysis. Not stored in this repository (see [../README.md](../README.md)).

| File | Relevance |
| --- | --- |
| SY 2025-2026 SCHOOL LEVEL DATA ON ENROLLMENT BY SCHOOL.xlsx | Latest school-level enrollment, SY 2025–26. Denominator for enrollment shares and prevalence (Q1–Q6) |
| public_school_coordinates.parquet | Public school coordinates with PSGC codes, municipal income class, and urban/rural flag. Used to locate schools and compute 3 km access (Q4–Q6) |
| private_school_coordinates.parquet | Private school coordinates with PSGC codes, municipal income class, and urban/rural flag. Used to locate schools and compute 3 km access (Q4–Q6) |
| consolidated_geodata_matched.gpkg | Barangay-level boundary polygons (MULTIPOLYGON) with PSGC codes. Used for maps (Q1–Q6) |
